content_en.prompt: Tushar is traveling with his autonomous car. A recent software bug causes it to make the same turn every time it reaches the same type of intersection: it always turns left at every circle, always turns right at every T-intersection, and always goes straight through every +-intersection.
content_en.question: Which letter will be reached during Tushar's journey?
content_en.explanation: Following the rules: at the first circle the car turns left (going up); at the next T-intersection it turns right; it goes straight through the +-intersection; it turns right at the next T-intersection at the top of the map; and finally it goes straight through the last +-intersection and stops at F.
content_en.ct_explanation: It's a typical situation in computer science to observe a dynamic system controlled by an algorithm following certain fixed rules — future behaviour can only be predicted by carefully analysing the algorithm and determining exactly which rules it follows. The system under study could be a real-life system or a software system, for example one being debugged. Solving this task requires good pattern recognition as well as algorithmic thinking.

content_zh.prompt: Tushar坐著他的自駕車出門，車子最近的軟體更新出現了一個嚴重的bug：每次遇到同一種路口，它都會做出同樣的轉彎——每個圓環路口一律左轉，每個丁字路口一律右轉，每個十字路口一律直走。
content_zh.question: Tushar的旅程中，會抵達哪一個字母標示的地點？
content_zh.explanation: 依照這些規則推算：在第一個圓環路口車子左轉（往上走）；接著在下一個丁字路口右轉；直直穿過十字路口；在地圖最上方的下一個丁字路口又右轉；最後直直穿過最後一個十字路口，停在F。
content_zh.ct_explanation: 在電腦科學裡，觀察一個由演算法依照固定規則控制的動態系統，是很典型的情境——只有仔細分析這套演算法、確認它到底遵循哪些規則，才能預測系統未來的行為。被研究的系統可能是真實世界的系統，也可能是軟體系統，例如正在除錯的程式。要解開這一題，需要良好的樣式辨識能力，也需要演算法思維。
